units.source_text: 原来，在樱林路上摆着成排的大折凳，人们喝呀唱的，吵吵嚷嚷，弄得乱糟糟的。

en.t: It turned out that rows of large folding stools had been set out along Cherry Grove Road, and people were drinking and singing, shouting noisily, and making the whole place a mess.

units.source_text: 还有些乡下老太婆兴高采烈地跳着舞，也有的醉汉打起震耳的鼾声，从折凳上滚落下来。

en.t: Some old women from the countryside were dancing in high spirits, while some drunken men began snoring loudly enough to shake the ears and rolled down from the folding stools.
